meaning:
πλάξ, -ακός, ἡ
[in LXX for לוּחַ ;]
anything flat and broad.
1. a plain (poët.).
2. In late writers (Luc., al.), a flat stone, a tablet: 2Co.3:3, Heb.9:4.†
